messages:
ari: Quick check — are we rotating TLS session ticket keys on the edge fleet monthly? I couldn't find it in the runbook.

infra-bot: Deploy note: automated ticket key rotation job exists on infra-kms-rotation, last run 2026-02-14.

joel: We rotate L4 session tickets (ticket_key_id) every 30 days for hosted edge. Private deployments left to customer; see infra runbook link: https://internal.redwood/infra/runbooks/tls-session-keys

ari: Are the rotation keys stored in KMS or in vaults on hosts? Need this for a SOC request.

maria: They are in KMS (projects/redwood-kms). Only kms-admins & security-service-account can decrypt. Logs are redacted; we never log raw session ticket secrets. 

sam: Can we get short approval to grant the audit team read-only access to the key metadata (not key material)?

maria: Approved for audit-team@redwood for 30 days, request PR to infra-iam with justification. :white_check_mark:

ari: I'll open the PR. Also, quick config check — nginx uses `ssl_session_tickets on; ssl_session_timeout 1d;` should that be 1d or 30d?

joel: ssl_session_timeout controls session lifetime; ticket rotation is separate. We use 1d for session timeout, and rotate keys monthly. Example config in infra repo:

```
ssl_session_tickets on;
ssl_session_timeout 24h;
# key rotation handled by infra-kms-rotation service
```

maria: Please add a note to the runbook that logs must mask ticket identifiers (slice of ticket id) and include retention policy. I'll review the PR once created.

ari: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge/1234 — includes IAM change and runbook note. tagging @maria @joel

maria: Reviewing now, will merge after CI and a short audit log check. Thanks!

joel: FYI, for Dedicated customers we track whether session tickets are disabled per-customer; runbook has checklist for on-prem.

ari: Great, closing the loop. :thumbsup:
